english.title: Operator or pilot in command of public transport aircraft carrying equipment not approved by CAA
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]

of a public transport aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which carried equipment listed in Schedule 6 to the Air Navigation Order 2016, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), which was not

(C)_[of a type]_
(D)_[installed in a manner]_

approved by the CAA in that **(..SPECIFY CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 119(3) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: (i) Article 119(3) was amended on Exit Day to exclude approval by EASA - for offences prior to Exit Day, please see offence document H19117.
